parole.significato: cadence (progression of chords closing a piece or section)
parole.testo: Borrowed from Italian cadenza or via German Kadenz (itself from Italian), from Latin cadentia. Doublet of kans, sjans, and cadans.
Shortening of violoncello, from Italian violoncello. Influenced by German Cello.

parole.significato: a duet (musical piece performed by two players or two singers)
parole.testo: Borrowed from Italian duetto or German Duett (itself borrowed from Italian).

parole.significato: bassoon (musical instrument in the woodwind family)
parole.testo: Borrowed from Italian fagotto. Later borrowed again from German Fagott. The theory that the name derives from a faggot of stick in reference to the way the parts of a bassoon are stored is a pseudo-etymology.
